parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate a suspended metre ruler and determine the weight of the metre ruler. Refer to Fig. 1.1. Do not change the position of the loops of thread attached to the force meters. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Move the 1.50 N load to a distance d = 40.0 cm from the 0.0 cm end of the ruler. Raise or lower one clamp slightly, if necessary, so that the metre ruler is as near to horizontal as possible. Read the value F X on force meter X and the value F Y on force meter Y. F X = ........................................................... N F Y = ........................................................... N Calculate a value W X using the equation W X = F X + F Y – k, where k = 1.50 N. W X = ........................................................... N [1]

ms.label: 1(a)(i)
ms.text: FX and FY present AND calculate value for WX

ms.label: 1(a)(ii)
ms.text:
suitable procedure
e.g. measure distance/height to bench in 2 places AND make sure equal

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Move the 1.50 N load to a distance d = 10.0 cm from the 0.0 cm end of the ruler. Ensure that the metre ruler is as near to horizontal as possible. Read, and record in Table 1.1, the value F X on force meter X. Repeat this procedure for d = 30.0 cm, 50.0 cm, 70.0 cm and 90.0 cm. Table 1.1 d / cm F X / N 10.0 30.0 50.0 70.0 90.0 [2]

ms.label: 1(b)
ms.text:
5 FX values all increasing
consistent d.p.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Plot a graph of F X / N (y-axis) against d / cm (x-axis). Start the axes at the origin (0, 0). Draw a best-fit straight line. 0 0 [4]

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text:
axes labelled with quantity and unit
appropriate scales (plots occupying at least ½ grid)
plots all correct to ± ½ small square AND precise plots
well-judged line AND thin line

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) From your graph, determine F 0 , the value of F X when d = 0.0 cm. F 0 = ............................................................... Calculate the weight W R of the metre ruler, using the equation W R = 2 × F 0 . W R = ........................................................... N [2]

ms.label: 1(d)
ms.text:
intercept read correctly from graph and recorded
WR within 10% of WX

ms.label: 1(e)
ms.text: statement matching plots AND reference to pattern
